title: LinkedIn launches new effort in push to capture business advertisers
title_zh: LinkedIn 推出新举措以吸引商业广告商
summary: LinkedIn is aiming to burnish its position as a go-to platform for business advertisers with a new team of marketing experts ‌that it expects to generate an annualized run rate of $100 million next fiscal year, ‌a source familiar with the matter said.
summary_zh: 一位知情人士表示，LinkedIn 的目标是通过一支新的营销专家团队来提升其作为商业广告商首选平台的地位，预计下一财年的年化营业额将达到 1 亿美元。

title: Global AI debt issuance to top $500 billion in 2026, Morgan Stanley says
title_zh: 摩根士丹利表示，2026 年全球人工智能债券发行量将突破 5000 亿美元
summary: Morgan Stanley forecasts AI-related global debt issuance to more than double ‌to nearly $570 billion in 2026, pointing to ‌rising bond supply and credit market activity as hyperscalers turn ​to alternative funding sources to meet massive AI-driven capex needs.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利预测，到 2026 年，与人工智能相关的全球债务发行量将增加一倍以上，达到近 5700 亿美元，并指出，随着超大规模企业转向替代融资来源以满足人工智能驱动的大规模资本支出需求，债券供应和信贷市场活动将不断增加。

title: TSMC’s Monthly Sales Rise 30% Thanks to Sustained AI Chip Demand
title_zh: AI芯片需求持续旺盛，台积电月销售额增长30%
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. reported a 30% rise in its monthly sales, reflecting continued strength in demand spurred by a global rush to build AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——台积电公布其月销售额增长 30%，反映出全球热衷于建设人工智能基础设施刺激的需求持续强劲。

title: Meta deepens partnership with Ambani's Reliance with AI data centre
title_zh: Meta 深化与 Ambani 旗下 Reliance 人工智能数据中心的合作
summary: Meta Platforms will lease an AI-ready data centre to be built by billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries, ‌the U.S. tech major said on Wednesday, deepening ties with the Indian ‌conglomerate.
summary_zh: 这家美国科技巨头周三表示，Meta Platforms 将租赁一个人工智能数据中心，由亿万富翁穆克什·安巴尼 (Mukesh Ambani) 的信实工业 (Reliance Industries) 建造，加深与这家印度企业集团的联系。

title: There's more 'adoption of options' among retail traders: Schwab
title_zh: 施瓦布：散户交易者更多地“采用期权”
summary: Retail investors are piling back into AI trade leaders, according to the latest Schwab Trading Activity Index (STAX) report.
summary_zh: 根据最新的施瓦布交易活动指数（STAX）报告，散户投资者正在涌入人工智能贸易领军企业。

title: Why Elon Musk's track record of unfilled promises matters for investors
title_zh: 为什么埃隆·马斯克未兑现承诺的记录对投资者很重要
summary: As Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk prepares to expand his corporate empire through SpaceX's IPO this Friday, June 12, should his promises and vision be met with a healthy dose of skepticism by investors?
summary_zh: 当特斯拉 (TSLA) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 准备通过 SpaceX 于 6 月 12 日周五进行 IPO 来扩大他的企业帝国时，他的承诺和愿景是否会受到投资者的适当怀疑？

title: What massive SpaceX-Alphabet compute deal means ahead of IPO
title_zh: IPO 前 SpaceX 与 Alphabet 的大规模计算交易意味着什么
summary: SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) continues to turn investors' heads ahead of its IPO this Friday, June 12, as Elon Musk's space company strikes a deal with Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) for the Big Tech company to borrow computing power for $920 million per month.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 在 6 月 12 日星期五首次公开募股 (IPO) 前继续吸引投资者的目光，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的太空公司与 Alphabet (GOOG、GOOGL) 达成协议，让这家大型科技公司每月以 9.2 亿美元的价格借用计算能力。

title: Tim Cook signs off his last WWDC
title_zh: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 结束他最后一次 WWDC
summary: End of an era... Tim Cook’s LAST WWDC.
summary_zh: 一个时代的结束……蒂姆·库克的最后一次 WWDC。

title: Anthropic launches Mythos-class Claude Fable 5 model, available to the public
title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Mythos 级 Claude Fable 5 模型，向公众开放
summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5, its most powerful AI model yet.
summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了迄今为止最强大的人工智能模型 Claude Fable 5。
